stem:
Create a number line that best represents the solution to the inequality shown.

-6k + 6 < -48
instruction: Select a ray. Move the point on the ray to the correct place on the number line.
visual_elements: number line from -10 to 10 with arrows on both ends
four ray options: filled circle with left arrow, open circle with left arrow, open circle with right arrow, filled circle with right arrow
